versions.changelog:
- Initial release of aux-mcp: "Spotify for your AI" with DJ, party, roast, and auto-DJ features via MCP integration.
- Supports mood-based music selection, playlist roasting, weekly reports, party rooms, and dynamic DJ features through user queries.
- Provides setup instructions for both CLI and OpenClaw integration.
- Requires Spotify Premium for playback; browsing and searching work with just client credentials.
- Includes guidance for preferred tool use, error handling, and displaying interactive ASCII cards from tool responses.

Initial release; renamed skill from aux-mcp to aux.

- Skill name changed from "aux-mcp" to "aux" throughout.
- Updated install path in documentation to use the new name.
- No changes to contract, features, or functionality.
